body:
## Summary
- add structured peripheral/native pointer/controller diagnostics while keeping external acceptance gates explicit
- enable USB/LAN clients to advertise the generic peripheral-input framework so rejected PeripheralEvent ACKs can reach diagnostics
- reject unsupported native pointer button bits before Protocol v1 wire submission
- correlate generic peripheral InputAck rejections back to Android diagnostics, including unsupported_peripheral_kind
- keep native pointer HID acceptance parser compatible with legacy and structured logs

## Verification
- `git diff --check`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.ControllerSessionFeedbackTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.PeripheralInputDiagnosticsTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityControllerForwardingContractTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.ActionableErrorDriftTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.NativeInputWireTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.StreamInputDispatcherTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.protocol.ProtocolV1SessionTest' --tests 'dev.telemachus.display.StreamClientProtocolV1IntegrationTest.peripheralInputRejectedAckReachesDiagnosticCallback'`
- `make actionable-error-states-gate`
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools:scripts python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_native_pointer_hid_acceptance scripts.tests.test_peripheral_host_ready_fail_closed tools.tests.test_native_pointer_hid`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`

## Evidence boundary
This PR improves offline/source readiness and diagnostics only. It does not close native pointer HID mouse acceptance, controller runtime acceptance, physical stylus acceptance, or any Host/device evidence gate.
title: Add peripheral input diagnostics and pointer guards
